calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-19-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Lavon Granger
Appearance by Paul Liu, Esq. Petitioner mother and father of minor present sworn and examined; Minor's aunt, Angela Cheung and minor's grandmother Sim Cheung present as witnesses.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to BENJAMIN SAECHAO CHEUNG.
Decree signed in open court.
